chunks: Jabir narrated from Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
"Whoever is sealed with the fasting of a day shall enter Paradise."

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja‘far, Imam Muhammad al-Baqir عليه السلام
key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, the abode of eternal reward
key_terms.بِصِيَامِ: with fasting; in the state of observing a fast
key_terms.جَابِرٌ: Jabir, the narrator transmitting this hadith
key_terms.خُتِمَ: was concluded or sealed at the end of one's life

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for someone whose life ends while fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if a person's life concludes while they are in the state of fasting for a day, they will enter Paradise. It highlights the great merit of fasting and the blessedness of ending one's life upon an act of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1802 - It is narrated by Jabir from Abu Ja‘far (Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as)), who said:
"Whoever's life ends while fasting on a day will enter Paradise."
